title: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 8: Ulaguzi wa binadamu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child puts people and animals in A-WA (a-/wa-) whatever their prefix, and trees, plants and many m- things in U-I (u-/i-).
steps: Is it a person or animal?
If a tree or m-/mi- thing, U-I.

board.say: Ni kiumbe hai, kwa hiyo ngeli gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mti ni wa ngeli gani?" Kwa nini "A-WA" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mti ni wa ngeli ya U-I; wingi wake ni miti.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto ni wa ngeli gani?" Kwa nini "U-I" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mtoto ni mtu, kwa hiyo ni wa ngeli ya A-WA.

listen_for: Mti unakua na mtoto anakua zinakua
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Mti unakua na mtoto anakua zinakua" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: A-WA: a-, wa-. U-I: u-, i-.

misconceptions.ask: Mbwa ni kiumbe hai au kitu?
misconceptions.repair: Wanyama wote huchukua upatanisho wa A-WA: mbwa ameumwa.
